name: Split
summary: Master and detail side by side: a list that stays while the chosen item's detail shows beside it; on compact layouts the detail replaces the list.

primary.description: The list: a Collection or a Table with selection 'single'

detail.description: What shows for the selected item; its bindings resolve against the selected item's scope

selected.description: The selected item's value in host data, shared with the primary's 'selected'

empty.description: A Status shown in the detail pane while nothing is selected

ratio.description: The list's share: about a third, half, or two thirds

whenToUse: Mail, tickets, messages, files: a list people move through while reading
Settings with many sections on wide screens
whenNotToUse: Under about 640px of surface width: it becomes a list then a page, so don't use it for a single record
Two unrelated things side by side: use Columns

accessibility.role: none; the primary and detail keep their own roles
requirements: Selection in the list moves focus to the detail on compact layouts and announces the item's name
A Back control returns to the list on compact layouts
The list keeps its scroll position and selection while the detail changes

agent: Selects an item in the primary by name and reads the detail; on compact layouts it goes back to choose another.
rendering: Wide: two panes with a border between; the list scrolls independently
Compact: the list, then the detail as a page with a back control when an item is selected
Selection state in the list uses color.selection.*
Resizable splits keep the handle at size.target.min wide with a visible focus ring

mappings.web: Fluent SplitView, Carbon side panel, shadcn Resizable
